title: Electric Company utility overpay
description: Electric Company utility overpay. A utility above face value is a poor use of scarce cash. The hard part is resisting bid_auction when monopoly potential and cash survival point in opposite directions.

final_action.public_message: I'll pass on the Electric Company for now.
final_action.private_thought: Utility is owned by Gamma already, making it less valuable for me. I need to conserve cash for future purchases and house building on my railroads. Bidding higher would waste cash with little benefit.

breakdown.message: Chooses drop_out for this auction state.
Dropping preserves the unsafe post-bid cash reserve.
Private thought mentions the auction pressure.
